title: The State of Multilingual LLM Safety Research: From Measuring the Language Gap to Mitigating It

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic bibliometric review and manual annotation of nearly 300 LLM safety publications from 2020-2024 to quantify the research disparity between English and non-English languages, alongside an analysis of cross-lingual safety performance disparities (harmlessness scores) using existing model benchmark data.
